entries.source_evidence:
Player exact directive at Day276 early evening, after purchasing one Pixie Dust packet for145gp and restocking to21 ration-person-days/28 horse feed animal-days: "Let make for an inn, and rest for the day. See if there is anything else interesting around/in the city". This authorizes ordinary reasonable inn accommodation and stable care and the remaining evening/night's rest, and ordinary low-risk gathering of publicly known city attractions, NOT an extended downtime, official audiences, forced adventure, magical sale or further party expenditure. Party V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar and owned 4-horse intact coach enter a comfortable secure independent city inn in Caer Veylan's merchant district, newly introduced proprietor adult Hessa calls it The Copper Hearth. Spend 4 comfortable inn-stay shares at standard2014PHB 8sp each =3gp2sp, four horses' ordinary stable shares5sp each =2gp, three eating companions Mara/Cirren/Fenar supper and following breakfast at5sp each for 3x2=3gp. V Reborn does not need a meal. Owner prices disclosed and ordinary nonconsequential lodging service approved by request. Total cost 8gp2sp paid ONCE from V purse982gp5sp6cp ->974gp3sp6cp, no extra estate or carriage costs, and no meal/ration/horse-feed inventory consumption: paid inn feeding and stabling covers this one protected city evening/morning, stock remains21 rations/28 feed for future travel. No new potion/healing item or lodging invented as a special luxury. No predeclared independent hostile event under guarded, secured inn, no exposed-road random encounter percentile roll for protected town lodging. At dawn Day277 the qualifying safe CITY overnight adds2 weighted Long Rest units to prior4/6 ->6/6, completes this 6-unit Long Rest then resets new-cycle progress to0/6. All PCs return/retain maximum HP, all HD recover up to2014 half character level: Fenar Beast Barbarian6 HD4/6->6/6 (two recovered), V Rogue4/Fighter3 HD7/7 unchanged, Cirren Knowledge Cleric6 HD6/6 unchanged; V48/48 full MP7/7, Psi6/6, SecondWind1/1 ActionSurge1/1 Superiority4/4 etc; Fenar59/59 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6; Cirren51/51 slots L1 4/4 L2 3/3 L3 3/3 ChannelDivinity2/2; Mara and all horses healthy; silver sword/A-04/Clockwork Amulet and sole unopened Pixie Dust packet remain V's, unused. No level-up/vision magic/rest miracle.
At inn over evening supper and morning breakfast Hessa freely describes ordinary Caer Veylan's accessible sights/opportunities without skill-gated rumors: busy merchant freight exchange with eastbound coach/caravan route notices and roadbooks toward Eastwatch (Cirren interested); an old civic survey-stone display accessible via public civic square (Mara interested in historical comparison, no proven Nightglass/Silver Court artifact/quest clue); public disciplined Veyran garrison exercise at the parade ground (Fenar curious, regime remains authoritarian and ordinary functioning city); a lively regular artisan/performance arcade with nonmagical craftsmen/performers (Fenar enjoys) and existing Keld household and commercial Harrow & Pike offices known to be in Caer Veylan from previously established map/geography (but do not claim current specific person at home, their present business, testimony or invitation). City attractions are optional independently open settings, not pre-resolved visits, player-owned quest acceptance or paid tours. Stop Day277 morning at inn with party just breakfasted and no destinations yet chosen; no Day277 road day encounter rolled, no onward Eastwatch departure or new Magic Shop stock.
entries.pending_action: Day277 morning after quiet safe-town overnight at the Copper Hearth in Caer Veylan. Full Long Rest 4/6+2=6/6 completed, next weighted rest cycle0/6; Fenar HD6/6 restored, V48/48 HD7/7 and Cirren51/51 HD6/6, all other combat features/spells full, Fenar59/59 Rage4/4 Shift3/3. V personal purse974gp3sp6cp after ordinary inn/stable/supper/breakfast expense8gp2sp once, travel reserves21 rations-person-days and28 horse-feed animal-days untouched. One Pixie Dust packet still sealed and owned by V; 4 healthy horses and coach stable. Hessa the new ordinary innkeeper offers optional city activities: carriage/freight exchange eastward road notices, public historic survey stone display, Veyran garrison exercise ground, city artisans/performance arcade; previously canon Keld household and Harrow & Pike are in Caer Veylan but no current meeting guaranteed. No Day277 encounter, new purchases or travel movement. Await V's choice what to explore or whether to depart toward Eastwatch.

entries.source_evidence: Latest explicit player correction after Day276→277 Copper Hearth inn rest adjudicated: "just two rooms". This overrides previous assistant assumption of four separate comfortable rooms at 8sp each, NOT the four party members, companion autonomy, three eaters' two meals, four-horse stabling, elapsed rest, sleep quality, location, or actual first Caer Veylan resupply. Accommodation for four party members in TWO rooms rather than four at stated room rate8sp each is 2x8sp=1gp6sp (instead of 4x8sp=3gp2sp). Stabling and coach parking 2gp and three eater supper+breakfast3gp unchanged. Corrected bill TOTAL6gp6sp rather than8gp2sp, relief1gp6sp. From purse BEFORE inn982gp5sp6cp, corrected balance AFTER inn975gp9sp6cp, replacing inaccurate previous974gp3sp6cp; don't post this as fresh unrelated revenue if original owner costs not posted. Existing rest outcome stays: overnight safe city qualifies+2 weighted units LongRest4/6->6/6 then reset cycle0/6 at dawn277, Fenar spentHD4/6->6/6, V/Cirren full; all HP/spell/resources unchanged. Party provisions21 ration-person-days/feed28 animal-days unchanged because meals and horse care paid locally, one Pixie Dust packet still sealed, four owned horses and coach intact. Room assignment inside the two shared rooms is NOT dictated or presumed by this correction; adult travelers may choose their arrangements. No new game time, roll, spend, lodging, travel or adventure introduced. Supersedes the inn ROOM COUNT/COST and consequent purse figures in source event D276-277-CAER-VEYLAN-COPPER-HEARTH-REST-001 and pending PR15 transport, not its rest or care facts. Last explicit player correction takes priority for downstream owner sync; if old owner legs already posted, reconcile one-time difference1gp6sp with linked correction event ID rather than double-charging or double-refunding.
